university: SUNY College of Environmental Science and Forestry
notes: SUNY ESF is an environmental science, forestry, engineering, and design college. Its roughly 19 undergraduate majors (e.g. Environmental Science, Environmental Resources Engineering, Landscape Architecture, Paper Science and Engineering, Biotechnology) include no bachelor's program in computer science or computing, per a web search of the ESF catalog and major listings (esf.edu catalog; Common App ESF majors list). Per v2/COURSE_COLLECT.md section 1, program is null and collection stops.
